const int MOD = 1000000007;

using BS = bitset<128>;

int N, cnt, P[7][7];
vector<unordered_map<BS, int>> id_vec(2);
vector<vector<int>> dp(2, vector<int>(70003));
vector<vector<int>> trans(70003, vector<int>(128));
vector<int> prob(128);
int iv100;

int poww(long long a, int b) {
    int result = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) result = (result * a) % MOD;
        a = (a * a) % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int dfs(BS &x, int idx) {
    if (id_vec[idx].count(x)) return id_vec[idx][x];
    int nd = id_vec[idx][x] = ++cnt;
    BS tmp[7], tp;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); ++j) {
            tmp[i][j | (1 << i)] = tmp[i][j | (1 << i)] | x[j];
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << N); ++i) {
        tp = x;
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            if (i >> j & 1) tp |= tmp[j];
        }
        trans[nd][i] = dfs(tp, idx ^ 1);
    }
    return nd;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> N;
    BS tmp;
    tmp.set(0);
    dfs(tmp, 0);
    
    iv100 = poww(100, MOD - 2);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            cin >> P[i][j];
        }
    }
    
    dp[0][1] = 1;
    int x = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); ++j) {
            prob[j] = 1;
            for (int k = 0; k < N; ++k) {
                prob[j] = (1LL * prob[j] * iv100 % MOD) * ((j >> k & 1) ? P[i][k] : (100 - P[i][k])) % MOD;
            }
        }
        
        fill(dp[x ^= 1].begin(), dp[x ^= 1].end(), 0);
        for (int j = 1; j <= cnt; ++j) {
            if (dp[x ^ 1][j]) {
                for (int k = 0; k < (1 << N); ++k) {
                    dp[x][trans[j][k]] = (dp[x][trans[j][k]] + 1LL * dp[x ^ 1][j] * prob[k]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << N); ++i) tmp.set(i);
    cout << dp[x][id_vec[0][tmp]] << endl;
    
    return 0;

unordered_map<BSet, int> state_id;
vector<vector<int>> transition;
vector<int> state_dp[2];

        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return (int)result;
}

int compute_state_id(BSet bs) {
    if (state_id.find(bs) != state_id.end()) return state_id[bs];
    
    int new_id = state_id[bs] = ++cnt;
    BSet derived[7], current;
    
    // Precompute derived states
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
            derived[i][mask | (1 << i)] = derived[i][mask | (1 << i)] | bs[mask];
        }
    }
    
    // Build transitions
    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
        current = bs;
        for (int bit = 0; bit < N; ++bit) {
            if (mask >> bit & 1) current |= derived[bit];
        }
        transition[new_id][mask] = compute_state_id(current);
    }
    
    return new_id;
}

    cin >> N;

    transition.resize(70003, vector<int>(128));
    
    init_state.set(0);

    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            cin >> P[i][j];
        }
    }
    
    // Initialize DP
    state_dp[0].assign(70003, 0);
    state_dp[1].assign(70003, 0);
    state_dp[0][1] = 1;
    
    probability_cache.resize(1 << N);
    
    int current = 0;
    for (int stage = 0; stage < N; ++stage) {
        // Precompute probabilities for this stage
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
            probability_cache[mask] = 1;
            for (int k = 0; k < N; ++k) {

#include <iostream>

#include <functional>
using namespace std;

using State = bitset<128>;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int N;
int prob_mat[7][7];
int inv100;
map<State, int> state_to_index;
vector<int> trans_table[70003][128];
int dp[2][70003];

int mod_exp(int base, int exp) {
    int result = 1;
    base %= MOD;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (long long)result * base % MOD;
        base = (long long)base * base % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int assign_state_id(State& s) {
    auto it = state_to_index.find(s);
    if (it != state_to_index.end()) return it->second;
    
    int id = state_to_index[s] = (int)state_to_index.size();
    State next[7];
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
            if (mask & (1 << i)) continue;
            next[i][mask | (1 << i)] = next[i][mask] | s[mask];
        }
    }
    
    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
        State accumulated = s;
        for (int bit = 0; bit < N; ++bit) {
            if (mask >> bit & 1) accumulated |= next[bit];
        }
        trans_table[id][mask] = assign_state_id(accumulated);
    }
    
    return id;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> N;
    
    State initial;
    initial.set(0);
    assign_state_id(initial);
    
    inv100 = mod_exp(100, MOD - 2);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)
            cin >> prob_mat[i][j];
    
    int cur = 0;
    memset(dp, 0, sizeof(dp));
    dp[0][1] = 1;
    
    int total_states = (int)state_to_index.size();
    
    for (int round = 0; round < N; ++round) {
        vector<int> probs(1 << N);
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
            probs[mask] = 1;
            for (int k = 0; k < N; ++k) {
                int coefficient = (mask >> k & 1) ? prob_mat[round][k] : (100 - prob_mat[round][k]);
                probs[mask] = (long long)probs[mask] * inv100 % MOD * coefficient % MOD;
            }
        }
        
        memset(dp[cur ^ 1], 0, sizeof(dp[cur ^ 1]));
        
        for (int s = 1; s <= total_states; ++s) {
            if (!dp[cur][s]) continue;
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
                int next_s = trans_table[s][mask];
                dp[cur ^ 1][next_s] = (dp[cur ^ 1][next_s] + (long long)dp[cur][s] * probs[mask]) % MOD;
            }
        }
        
        cur ^= 1;
    }
    
    State full;
    full.set();
    cout << dp[cur][state_to_index[full]] << "\n";
    
    return 0;
}

    struct memoizer {
        unordered_map<state_t, int> mapping;
        vector<vector<int>> transitions;
        int counter = 0;
        
        int get_or_create(const state_t& s) {
            auto it = mapping.find(s);
            if (it != mapping.end()) return it->second;
            
            int id = counter++;
            mapping[s] = id;
            
            state_t derived[7] = {};
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); ++j) {
                    if (j >> i & 1) continue;
                    derived[i][j | (1 << i)] = derived[i][j] | s[j];
                }
            }
            
            transitions[id].resize(128);
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
                state_t curr = s;
                for (int bit = 0; bit < N; ++bit) {
                    if (mask >> bit & 1) curr |= derived[bit];
                }
                transitions[id][mask] = get_or_create(curr);
            }
            
            return id;
        }
    };
}

int N, P[7][7], inv100;
int dp[2][70003];

int modpow(long long base, int exp) {
    long long result = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % detail::MOD;
        base = (base * base) % detail::MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return (int)result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    cin >> N;
    
    detail::memoizer m;
    m.transitions.resize(70003);
    state_t init;
    init.set(0);
    m.get_or_create(init);
    
    inv100 = modpow(100, detail::MOD - 2);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)
            cin >> P[i][j];
    
    int cur = 0;
    fill(dp[cur], dp[cur] + 70003, 0);
    dp[cur][1] = 1;
    
    vector<int> probs(1 << N);
    
    for (int stage = 0; stage < N; ++stage) {
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
            probs[mask] = 1;

                probs[mask] = (long long)probs[mask] * inv100 % detail::MOD * val % detail::MOD;
            }

                    (dp[cur ^ 1][m.transitions[s][mask]] +
